description: This file defines the internal workings of the Catalog class within the Orleans runtime, responsible for managing grain activations, deactivations, and silo status changes. It includes methods for activation lifecycle management, silo status handling, and internal state tracking.

classes.name: Catalog
classes.description: Manages grain activations, handles silo status events, and coordinates activation lifecycle within the Orleans runtime environment.

classes.name: SiloAddressLogValue
classes.description: A small struct wrapper providing a string representation of a SiloAddress for logging purposes.

methods.name: UnregisterMessageTarget
methods.description: Unregisters a message target activation and cancels its collection.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainForTesting
methods.description: Internal method for testing: unregisters a grain activation by its GrainId.

methods.name: GetOrCreateActivation
methods.description: Returns an existing activation or creates a new one, handling rehydration and activation processes.

methods.name: DeactivateActivations
methods.description: Gracefully deactivates a list of activations, waiting for completion.

methods.name: DeactivateAllActivations
methods.description: Deactivates all activations managed by the catalog, typically during shutdown.

methods.name: DeleteActivations
methods.description: Deletes specified activations based on provided addresses and deactivation reasons.

methods.name: OnSiloStatusChange
methods.description: Handles silo status change events, deactivating affected activations when a silo leaves the cluster.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle to initialize necessary components.
